{{afc comment|Wikidata entry [[Category:Has wikidata]][[d:Q11580589]] Wikidata name: [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 09:25, 11 June 2025 (UTC)}} '''Shiratori Shrine''' (白鳥神社) Shiratori Shrine (白鳥神社) is a Shinto shrine located in various parts of [[:en:Japan|Japan]]. Similarly to the shrine of {{ill|Otori Shrine (disambiguation)|Otori-Schrein (Begriffsklärung)|2=ja|3=大鳥神社 (曖昧さ回避)|4=zh|5=大鳥神社 (消歧義)|lt=Ōtori Faith|lt_ja=大鳥信仰|lt_de=Otori-Glauben|lt_zh=大鳥信仰|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Otori Shrine (disambiguation)|qq=|1=Ōtori Shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q65258929}}, many are shrines of '''Shiratori Faith''' (白鳥信仰) derived from the legend of [[:en:Yamato Takeru|Yamato Takeru]]. As a {{ill|Religious Corporation|Religiöse Körperschaft|2=ja|3=宗教法人|4=zh|5=宗教法人|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Religious Corporation|qq=|1=religious corporation|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q7311343}}, there are 111 Shiratori Shrines nationwide, one shrine whose native name contains “Shiratori Shrine (disambiguation)” and 6 Shiratori Sha exist.

<!--interwikis from wikidata-->[[ja:白鳥神社]] {{afc comment|Wikidata entry [[Category:Has wikidata]][[d:Q11580589]] Wikidata name: [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 09:25, 11 June 2025 (UTC)}} '''Shiratori Shrine''' (白鳥神社) Shiratori Shrine (白鳥神社) is a Shinto shrine located in various parts of [[:en:Japan|Japan]]. Similarly to the shrine of {{ill|Otori Shrine (disambiguation)|Otori-Schrein (Begriffsklärung)|2=ja|3=大鳥神社 (曖昧さ回避)|4=zh|5=大鳥神社 (消歧義)|lt=Ōtori Faith|lt_ja=大鳥信仰|lt_de=Otori-Glauben|lt_zh=大鳥信仰|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Otori Shrine (disambiguation)|qq=|1=Ōtori Shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q65258929}}, many are shrines of '''Shiratori Faith''' (白鳥信仰) derived from the legend of [[:en:Yamato Takeru|Yamato Takeru]]. As a {{ill|Religious Corporation|Religiöse Körperschaft|2=ja|3=宗教法人|4=zh|5=宗教法人|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Religious Corporation|qq=|1=religious corporation|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q7311343}}, there are 111 Shiratori Shrines nationwide, one shrine whose native name contains “Shiratori Shrine (disambiguation)” and 6 Shiratori Sha exist.

Similarly to the shrine of {{ill|Otori Shrine (disambiguation)|Otori-Schrein (Begriffsklärung)|2=ja|3=大鳥神社 (曖昧さ回避)|4=zh|5=大鳥神社 (消歧義)|lt=Ōtori Faith|lt_ja=大鳥信仰|lt_de=Otori-Glauben|lt_zh=大鳥信仰|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Otori Shrine (disambiguation)|qq=|1=Ōtori Shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q65258929}}, many are shrines of '''Shiratori Faith''' (白鳥信仰) derived from the legend of [[:en:Yamato Takeru|Yamato Takeru]]. As a {{ill|Religious Corporation|Religiöse Körperschaft|2=ja|3=宗教法人|4=zh|5=宗教法人|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Religious Corporation|qq=|1=religious corporation|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q7311343}}, there are 111 Shiratori Shrines nationwide, one shrine whose native name contains “Shiratori Shrine (disambiguation)” and 6 Shiratori Sha exist.

<!--interwikis from wikidata-->[[ja:白鳥神社]] {{afc comment|Wikidata entry [[Category:Has wikidata]][[da:d:Q11580589]] Wikidata name: [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 09:25, 11 June 2025 (UTC)}} '''Shiratori Shrine''' (白鳥神社) Shiratori Shrine (白鳥神社) is a Shinto shrine located in various parts of [[:en:Japan|Japan]]. Similarly to the shrine of {{ill|Otori Shrine (disambiguation)|Otori-Schrein (Begriffsklärung)|2=ja|3=大鳥神社 (曖昧さ回避)|4=zh|5=大鳥神社 (消歧義)|lt=Ōtori Faith|lt_ja=大鳥信仰|lt_de=Otori-Glauben|lt_zh=大鳥信仰|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Otori Shrine (disambiguation)|qq=|1=Ōtori Shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q65258929}}, many are shrines of '''Shiratori Faith''' (白鳥信仰) derived from the legend of [[:en:Yamato Takeru|Yamato Takeru]]. As a {{ill|Religious Corporation|Religiöse Körperschaft|2=ja|3=宗教法人|4=zh|5=宗教法人|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Religious Corporation|qq=|1=religious corporation|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q7311343}}, there are 111 Shiratori Shrines nationwide, one shrine whose native name contains “Shiratori Shrine (disambiguation)” and 6 Shiratori Sha exist.

<!--interwikis from wikidata-->[[ja:白鳥神社]] {{afc comment|Wikidata entry [[Category:Has wikidata]][[da:d:Q11580589]] Wikidata name: [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 09:25, 11 June 2025 (UTC)}} '''Shiratori Shrine''' (白鳥神社) Shiratori Shrine (白鳥神社) is a Shinto shrine located in various parts of [[:en:Japan|Japan]]. Similarly to the shrine of {{ill|Otori Shrine (disambiguation)|Otori-Schrein (Begriffsklärung)|2=ja|3=大鳥神社 (曖昧さ回避)|4=zh|5=大鳥神社 (消歧義)|lt=Ōtori Faith|lt_ja=大鳥信仰|lt_de=Otori-Glauben|lt_zh=大鳥信仰|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Otori Shrine (disambiguation)|qq=|1=Ōtori Shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q65258929}}, many are shrines of '''Shiratori Faith''' (白鳥信仰) derived from the legend of [[:en:Yamato Takeru|Yamato Takeru]]. As a {{ill|Religious Corporation|Religiöse Körperschaft|2=ja|3=宗教法人|4=zh|5=宗教法人|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Religious Corporation|qq=|1=religious corporation|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q7311343}}, there are 111 Shiratori Shrines nationwide, one shrine whose native name contains “Shiratori Shrine (disambiguation)” and 6 Shiratori Sha exist.

Similarly to the shrine of {{ill|Otori Shrine (disambiguation)|Otori-Schrein (Begriffsklärung)|2=ja|3=大鳥神社 (曖昧さ回避)|4=zh|5=大鳥神社 (消歧義)|lt=Ōtori Faith|lt_ja=大鳥信仰|lt_de=Otori-Glauben|lt_zh=大鳥信仰|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Otori Shrine (disambiguation)|1=Ōtori Shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q65258929}}, many are shrines of '''Shiratori Faith''' (白鳥信仰) derived from the legend of [[:en:Yamato Takeru|Yamato Takeru]]. As a {{ill|Religious Corporation|Religiöse Körperschaft|2=ja|3=宗教法人|4=zh|5=宗教法人|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Religious Corporation|1=religious corporation|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q7311343}}, there are 111 Shiratori Shrines nationwide, one shrine whose native name contains “Shiratori Shrine (disambiguation)” and 6 Shiratori Sha exist.

<!--interwikis from wikidata-->[[ja:白鳥神社]] {{afc comment|Wikidata entry [[Category:Has wikidata]][[da:d:Q11580589]] Wikidata name: [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 09:25, 11 June 2025 (UTC)}} '''Shiratori Shrine''' (白鳥神社) Shiratori Shrine (白鳥神社) is a Shinto shrine located in various parts of [[:en:Japan|Japan]]. Similarly to the shrine of {{ill|Otori Shrine (disambiguation)|Otori-Schrein (Begriffsklärung)|2=ja|3=大鳥神社 (曖昧さ回避)|4=zh|5=大鳥神社 (消歧義)|lt=Ōtori Faith|lt_ja=大鳥信仰|lt_de=Otori-Glauben|lt_zh=大鳥信仰|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Otori Shrine (disambiguation)|1=Ōtori Shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q65258929}}, many are shrines of '''Shiratori Faith''' (白鳥信仰) derived from the legend of [[:en:Yamato Takeru|Yamato Takeru]]. As a {{ill|Religious Corporation|Religiöse Körperschaft|2=ja|3=宗教法人|4=zh|5=宗教法人|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Religious Corporation|1=religious corporation|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q7311343}}, there are 111 Shiratori Shrines nationwide, one shrine whose native name contains “Shiratori Shrine (disambiguation)” and 6 Shiratori Sha exist.

<!--interwikis from wikidata-->[[ja:白鳥神社]] {{afc comment|Wikidata entry [[Category:Has wikidata]][[da:d:Q11580589]] Wikidata name: [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 09:25, 11 June 2025 (UTC)}} '''Shiratori Shrine''' (白鳥神社) Shiratori Shrine (白鳥神社) is a Shinto shrine located in various parts of [[:en:Japan|Japan]]. Similarly to the shrine of {{ill|Otori Shrine (disambiguation)|Otori-Schrein (Begriffsklärung)|2=ja|3=大鳥神社 (曖昧さ回避)|4=zh|5=大鳥神社 (消歧義)|lt=Ōtori Faith|lt_ja=大鳥信仰|lt_de=Otori-Glauben|lt_zh=大鳥信仰|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Otori Shrine (disambiguation)|1=Ōtori Shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q65258929}}, many are shrines of '''Shiratori Faith''' (白鳥信仰) derived from the legend of [[:en:Yamato Takeru|Yamato Takeru]]. As a {{ill|Religious Corporation|Religiöse Körperschaft|2=ja|3=宗教法人|4=zh|5=宗教法人|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Religious Corporation|1=religious corporation|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q7311343}}, there are 111 Shiratori Shrines nationwide, one shrine whose native name contains “Shiratori Shrine (disambiguation)” and 6 Shiratori Sha exist.

<!--interwikis from wikidata-->[[ja:白鳥神社]] {{afc comment|Wikidata entry [[Category:Has wikidata]][[da:d:Q11580589]] Wikidata name: [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 09:25, 11 June 2025 (UTC)}} '''Shiratori Shrine''' (白鳥神社) Shiratori Shrine (白鳥神社) is a Shinto shrine located in various parts of [[:en:Japan|Japan]]. Similarly to the shrine of {{ill|Otori Shrine (disambiguation)|Otori-Schrein (Begriffsklärung)|2=ja|3=大鳥神社 (曖昧さ回避)|4=zh|5=大鳥神社 (消歧義)|lt=Ōtori Faith|lt_ja=大鳥信仰|lt_de=Otori-Glauben|lt_zh=大鳥信仰|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Otori Shrine (disambiguation)|1=Ōtori Shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q65258929}}, many are shrines of '''Shiratori Faith''' (白鳥信仰) derived from the legend of [[:en:Yamato Takeru|Yamato Takeru]]. As a {{ill|Religious Corporation|Religiöse Körperschaft|2=ja|3=宗教法人|4=zh|5=宗教法人|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Religious Corporation|1=religious corporation|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q7311343}}, there are 111 Shiratori Shrines nationwide, one shrine whose native name contains “Shiratori Shrine (disambiguation)” and 6 Shiratori Sha exist.

<!--interwikis from wikidata-->[[ja:白鳥神社]] {{afc comment|Wikidata entry [[Category:Has wikidata]][[da:d:Q11580589]] Wikidata name: [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 09:25, 11 June 2025 (UTC)}} '''Shiratori Shrine''' (白鳥神社) Shiratori Shrine (白鳥神社) is a Shinto shrine located in various parts of [[:en:Japan|Japan]]. Similarly to the shrine of {{ill|Otori Shrine (disambiguation)|Otori-Schrein (Begriffsklärung)|2=ja|3=大鳥神社 (曖昧さ回避)|4=zh|5=大鳥神社 (消歧義)|lt=Ōtori Faith|lt_ja=大鳥信仰|lt_de=Otori-Glauben|lt_zh=大鳥信仰|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Otori Shrine (disambiguation)|1=Ōtori Shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q65258929}}, many are shrines of '''Shiratori Faith''' (白鳥信仰) derived from the legend of [[:en:Yamato Takeru|Yamato Takeru]]. As a {{ill|Religious Corporation|Religiöse Körperschaft|2=ja|3=宗教法人|4=zh|5=宗教法人|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Religious Corporation|1=religious corporation|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q7311343}}, there are 111 Shiratori Shrines nationwide, one shrine whose native name contains “Shiratori Shrine (disambiguation)” and 6 Shiratori Sha exist.

<!--interwikis from wikidata-->[[ja:白鳥神社]] {{afc comment|Wikidata entry [[Category:Has wikidata]][[da:d:Q11580589]] Wikidata name: [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 09:25, 11 June 2025 (UTC)}} '''Shiratori Shrine''' (白鳥神社) Shiratori Shrine (白鳥神社) is a Shinto shrine located in various parts of [[:en:Japan|Japan]]. Similarly to the shrine of {{ill|Otori Shrine (disambiguation)|Otori-Schrein (Begriffsklärung)|2=ja|3=大鳥神社 (曖昧さ回避)|4=zh|5=大鳥神社 (消歧義)|lt=Ōtori Faith|lt_ja=大鳥信仰|lt_de=Otori-Glauben|lt_zh=大鳥信仰|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Otori Shrine (disambiguation)|1=Ōtori Shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q65258929}}, many are shrines of '''Shiratori Faith''' (白鳥信仰) derived from the legend of [[:en:Yamato Takeru|Yamato Takeru]]. As a {{ill|Religious Corporation|Religiöse Körperschaft|2=ja|3=宗教法人|4=zh|5=宗教法人|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Religious Corporation|1=religious corporation|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q7311343}}, there are 111 Shiratori Shrines nationwide, one shrine whose native name contains “Shiratori Shrine (disambiguation)” and 6 Shiratori Sha exist.

<!--interwikis from wikidata-->[[ja:白鳥神社]] {{afc comment|Wikidata entry [[Category:Has wikidata]][[da:d:Q11580589]] Wikidata name: [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 09:25, 11 June 2025 (UTC)}} '''Shiratori Shrine''' (白鳥神社) Shiratori Shrine (白鳥神社) is a Shinto shrine located in various parts of [[:en:Japan|Japan]]. Similarly to the shrine of {{ill|Otori Shrine (disambiguation)|Otori-Schrein (Begriffsklärung)|2=ja|3=大鳥神社 (曖昧さ回避)|4=zh|5=大鳥神社 (消歧義)|lt=Ōtori Faith|lt_ja=大鳥信仰|lt_de=Otori-Glauben|lt_zh=大鳥信仰|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Otori Shrine (disambiguation)|1=Ōtori Shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q65258929}}, many are shrines of '''Shiratori Faith''' (白鳥信仰) derived from the legend of [[:en:Yamato Takeru|Yamato Takeru]]. As a {{ill|Religious Corporation|Religiöse Körperschaft|2=ja|3=宗教法人|4=zh|5=宗教法人|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Religious Corporation|1=religious corporation|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q7311343}}, there are 111 Shiratori Shrines nationwide, one shrine whose native name contains “Shiratori Shrine (disambiguation)” and 6 Shiratori Sha exist.

<!--interwikis from wikidata-->[[ja:白鳥神社]] {{afc comment|Wikidata entry [[Category:Has wikidata]][[da:d:Q11580589]] Wikidata name: [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 09:25, 11 June 2025 (UTC)}} '''Shiratori Shrine''' (白鳥神社) Shiratori Shrine (白鳥神社) is a Shinto shrine located in various parts of [[:en:Japan|Japan]]. Similarly to the shrine of {{ill|Otori Shrine (disambiguation)|Otori-Schrein (Begriffsklärung)|2=ja|3=大鳥神社 (曖昧さ回避)|4=zh|5=大鳥神社 (消歧義)|lt=Ōtori Faith|lt_ja=大鳥信仰|lt_de=Otori-Glauben|lt_zh=大鳥信仰|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Otori Shrine (disambiguation)|1=Ōtori Shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q65258929}}, many are shrines of '''Shiratori Faith''' (白鳥信仰) derived from the legend of [[:en:Yamato Takeru|Yamato Takeru]]. As a {{ill|Religious Corporation|Religiöse Körperschaft|2=ja|3=宗教法人|4=zh|5=宗教法人|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Religious Corporation|1=religious corporation|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q7311343}}, there are 111 Shiratori Shrines nationwide, one shrine whose native name contains “Shiratori Shrine (disambiguation)” and 6 Shiratori Sha exist.

<!--interwikis from wikidata-->[[ja:白鳥神社]] {{afc comment|Wikidata entry [[Category:Has wikidata]][[da:d:Q11580589]] Wikidata name: [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 09:25, 11 June 2025 (UTC)}} '''Shiratori Shrine''' (白鳥神社) Shiratori Shrine (白鳥神社) is a Shinto shrine located in various parts of [[:en:Japan|Japan]]. Similarly to the shrine of {{ill|Otori Shrine (disambiguation)|Otori-Schrein (Begriffsklärung)|2=ja|3=大鳥神社 (曖昧さ回避)|4=zh|5=大鳥神社 (消歧義)|lt=Ōtori Faith|lt_ja=大鳥信仰|lt_de=Otori-Glauben|lt_zh=大鳥信仰|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Otori Shrine (disambiguation)|1=Ōtori Shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q65258929}}, many are shrines of '''Shiratori Faith''' (白鳥信仰) derived from the legend of [[:en:Yamato Takeru|Yamato Takeru]]. As a {{ill|Religious Corporation|Religiöse Körperschaft|2=ja|3=宗教法人|4=zh|5=宗教法人|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Religious Corporation|1=religious corporation|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q7311343}}, there are 111 Shiratori Shrines nationwide, one shrine whose native name contains “Shiratori Shrine (disambiguation)” and 6 Shiratori Sha exist.

<!--interwikis from wikidata-->[[ja:白鳥神社]] {{afc comment|Wikidata entry [[Category:Has wikidata]][[da:d:Q11580589]] Wikidata name: [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 09:25, 11 June 2025 (UTC)}} '''Shiratori Shrine''' (白鳥神社) Shiratori Shrine (白鳥神社) is a Shinto shrine located in various parts of [[:en:Japan|Japan]]. Similarly to the shrine of {{ill|Otori Shrine (disambiguation)|Otori-Schrein (Begriffsklärung)|2=ja|3=大鳥神社 (曖昧さ回避)|4=zh|5=大鳥神社 (消歧義)|lt=Ōtori Faith|lt_ja=大鳥信仰|lt_de=Otori-Glauben|lt_zh=大鳥信仰|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Otori Shrine (disambiguation)|1=Ōtori Shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q65258929}}, many are shrines of '''Shiratori Faith''' (白鳥信仰) derived from the legend of [[:en:Yamato Takeru|Yamato Takeru]]. As a {{ill|Religious Corporation|Religiöse Körperschaft|2=ja|3=宗教法人|4=zh|5=宗教法人|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Religious Corporation|1=religious corporation|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q7311343}}, there are 111 Shiratori Shrines nationwide, one shrine whose native name contains “Shiratori Shrine (disambiguation)” and 6 Shiratori Sha exist.

<!--interwikis from wikidata-->[[ja:白鳥神社]] {{afc comment|Wikidata entry [[Category:Has wikidata]][[da:d:Q11580589]] Wikidata name: [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 09:25, 11 June 2025 (UTC)}} '''Shiratori Shrine''' (白鳥神社) Shiratori Shrine (白鳥神社) is a Shinto shrine located in various parts of [[:en:Japan|Japan]]. Similarly to the shrine of {{ill|Otori Shrine (disambiguation)|Otori-Schrein (Begriffsklärung)|2=ja|3=大鳥神社 (曖昧さ回避)|4=zh|5=大鳥神社 (消歧義)|lt=Ōtori Faith|lt_ja=大鳥信仰|lt_de=Otori-Glauben|lt_zh=大鳥信仰|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Otori Shrine (disambiguation)|1=Ōtori Shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q65258929}}, many are shrines of '''Shiratori Faith''' (白鳥信仰) derived from the legend of [[:en:Yamato Takeru|Yamato Takeru]]. As a {{ill|Religious Corporation|Religiöse Körperschaft|2=ja|3=宗教法人|4=zh|5=宗教法人|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Religious Corporation|1=religious corporation|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q7311343}}, there are 111 Shiratori Shrines nationwide, one shrine whose native name contains “Shiratori Shrine (disambiguation)” and 6 Shiratori Sha exist.

<!--interwikis from wikidata-->[[ja:白鳥神社]] {{afc comment|Wikidata entry [[Category:Has wikidata]][[da:d:Q11580589]] Wikidata name: [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 09:25, 11 June 2025 (UTC)}} '''Shiratori Shrine''' (白鳥神社) Shiratori Shrine (白鳥神社) is a Shinto shrine located in various parts of [[:en:Japan|Japan]]. Similarly to the shrine of {{ill|Otori Shrine (disambiguation)|Otori-Schrein (Begriffsklärung)|2=ja|3=大鳥神社 (曖昧さ回避)|4=zh|5=大鳥神社 (消歧義)|lt=Ōtori Faith|lt_ja=大鳥信仰|lt_de=Otori-Glauben|lt_zh=大鳥信仰|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Otori Shrine (disambiguation)|1=Ōtori Shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q65258929}}, many are shrines of '''Shiratori Faith''' (白鳥信仰) derived from the legend of [[:en:Yamato Takeru|Yamato Takeru]]. As a {{ill|Religious Corporation|Religiöse Körperschaft|2=ja|3=宗教法人|4=zh|5=宗教法人|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Religious Corporation|1=religious corporation|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q7311343}}, there are 111 Shiratori Shrines nationwide, one shrine whose native name contains “Shiratori Shrine (disambiguation)” and 6 Shiratori Sha exist.

<!--interwikis from wikidata-->[[ja:白鳥神社]] {{afc comment|Wikidata entry [[Category:Has wikidata]][[da:d:Q11580589]] Wikidata name: [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 09:25, 11 June 2025 (UTC)}} '''Shiratori Shrine''' (白鳥神社) Shiratori Shrine (白鳥神社) is a Shinto shrine located in various parts of [[:en:Japan|Japan]]. Similarly to the shrine of {{ill|Otori Shrine (disambiguation)|Otori-Schrein (Begriffsklärung)|2=ja|3=大鳥神社 (曖昧さ回避)|4=zh|5=大鳥神社 (消歧義)|lt=Ōtori Faith|lt_ja=大鳥信仰|lt_de=Otori-Glauben|lt_zh=大鳥信仰|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Otori Shrine (disambiguation)|1=Ōtori Shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q65258929}}, many are shrines of '''Shiratori Faith''' (白鳥信仰) derived from the legend of [[:en:Yamato Takeru|Yamato Takeru]]. As a {{ill|Religious Corporation|Religiöse Körperschaft|2=ja|3=宗教法人|4=zh|5=宗教法人|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Religious Corporation|1=religious corporation|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q7311343}}, there are 111 Shiratori Shrines nationwide, one shrine whose native name contains “Shiratori Shrine (disambiguation)” and 6 Shiratori Sha exist.

<!--interwikis from wikidata-->[[ja:白鳥神社]] {{afc comment|Wikidata entry [[Category:Has wikidata]][[da:d:Q11580589]] Wikidata name: [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 09:25, 11 June 2025 (UTC)}} '''Shiratori Shrine''' (白鳥神社) Shiratori Shrine (白鳥神社) is a Shinto shrine located in various parts of [[:en:Japan|Japan]]. Similarly to the shrine of {{ill|Otori Shrine (disambiguation)|Otori-Schrein (Begriffsklärung)|2=ja|3=大鳥神社 (曖昧さ回避)|4=zh|5=大鳥神社 (消歧義)|lt=Ōtori Faith|lt_ja=大鳥信仰|lt_de=Otori-Glauben|lt_zh=大鳥信仰|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Otori Shrine (disambiguation)|1=Ōtori Shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q65258929}}, many are shrines of '''Shiratori Faith''' (白鳥信仰) derived from the legend of [[:en:Yamato Takeru|Yamato Takeru]]. As a {{ill|Religious Corporation|Religiöse Körperschaft|2=ja|3=宗教法人|4=zh|5=宗教法人|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Religious Corporation|1=religious corporation|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q7311343}}, there are 111 Shiratori Shrines nationwide, one shrine whose native name contains “Shiratori Shrine (disambiguation)” and 6 Shiratori Sha exist.

<!--interwikis from wikidata-->[[ja:白鳥神社]] {{afc comment|Wikidata entry [[Category:Has wikidata]][[da:d:Q11580589]] Wikidata name: [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 09:25, 11 June 2025 (UTC)}} '''Shiratori Shrine''' (白鳥神社) Shiratori Shrine (白鳥神社) is a Shinto shrine located in various parts of [[:en:Japan|Japan]]. Similarly to the shrine of {{ill|Otori Shrine (disambiguation)|Otori-Schrein (Begriffsklärung)|2=ja|3=大鳥神社 (曖昧さ回避)|4=zh|5=大鳥神社 (消歧義)|lt=Ōtori Faith|lt_ja=大鳥信仰|lt_de=Otori-Glauben|lt_zh=大鳥信仰|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Otori Shrine (disambiguation)|1=Ōtori Shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q65258929}}, many are shrines of '''Shiratori Faith''' (白鳥信仰) derived from the legend of [[:en:Yamato Takeru|Yamato Takeru]]. As a {{ill|Religious Corporation|Religiöse Körperschaft|2=ja|3=宗教法人|4=zh|5=宗教法人|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Religious Corporation|1=religious corporation|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q7311343}}, there are 111 Shiratori Shrines nationwide, one shrine whose native name contains “Shiratori Shrine (disambiguation)” and 6 Shiratori Sha exist.

Similarly to the shrine of {{ill|Otori Shrine (disambiguation)|Otori-Schrein (Begriffsklärung)|2=ja|3=大鳥神社 (曖昧さ回避)|4=zh|5=大鳥神社 (消歧義)|lt=Ōtori Faith|lt_ja=大鳥信仰|lt_de=Otori-Glauben|lt_zh=大鳥信仰|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Otori Shrine (disambiguation)|1=Ōtori Shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q65258929}}, many are shrines of '''Shiratori Faith''' (白鳥信仰) derived from the legend of [[:en:Yamato Takeru|Yamato Takeru]]. As a {{ill|Religious Corporation|Religiöse Körperschaft|2=ja|3=宗教法人|4=zh|5=宗教法人|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Religious Corporation|1=religious corporation|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q7311343}}, there are 111 Shiratori Shrines nationwide, one shrine whose native name contains “Shiratori Shrine (disambiguation)” and 6 Shiratori Sha exist.

Similarly to the shrine of {{ill|Otori Shrine (disambiguation)|Otori-Schrein (Begriffsklärung)|2=ja|3=大鳥神社 (曖昧さ回避)|4=zh|5=大鳥神社 (消歧義)|lt=Ōtori Faith|lt_ja=大鳥信仰|lt_de=Otori-Glauben|lt_zh=大鳥信仰|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Otori Shrine (disambiguation)|1=Ōtori Shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q65258929}}, many are shrines of '''Shiratori Faith''' (白鳥信仰) derived from the legend of [[:en:Yamato Takeru|Yamato Takeru]]. As a {{ill|Religious Corporation|Religiöse Körperschaft|2=ja|3=宗教法人|4=zh|5=宗教法人|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Religious Corporation|1=religious corporation|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q7311343}}, there are 111 Shiratori Shrines nationwide, one shrine whose native name contains “Shiratori Shrine (disambiguation)” and 6 Shiratori Sha exist.

Similarly to the shrine of {{ill|Otori Shrine (disambiguation)|Otori-Schrein (Begriffsklärung)|2=ja|3=大鳥神社 (曖昧さ回避)|4=zh|5=大鳥神社 (消歧義)|lt=Ōtori Faith|lt_ja=大鳥信仰|lt_de=Otori-Glauben|lt_zh=大鳥信仰|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Otori Shrine (disambiguation)|1=Ōtori Shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q65258929}}, many are shrines of '''Shiratori Faith''' (白鳥信仰) derived from the legend of [[:en:Yamato Takeru|Yamato Takeru]]. As a {{ill|Religious Corporation|Religiöse Körperschaft|2=ja|3=宗教法人|4=zh|5=宗教法人|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Religious Corporation|1=religious corporation|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q7311343}}, there are 111 Shiratori Shrines nationwide, one shrine whose native name contains “Shiratori Shrine (disambiguation)” and 6 Shiratori Sha exist.

Similarly to the shrine of {{ill|Otori Shrine (disambiguation)|Otori-Schrein (Begriffsklärung)|2=ja|3=大鳥神社 (曖昧さ回避)|4=zh|5=大鳥神社 (消歧義)|lt=Ōtori Faith|lt_ja=大鳥信仰|lt_de=Otori-Glauben|lt_zh=大鳥信仰|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Otori Shrine (disambiguation)|1=Ōtori Shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q65258929}}, many are shrines of '''Shiratori Faith''' (白鳥信仰) derived from the legend of [[:en:Yamato Takeru|Yamato Takeru]]. As a {{ill|Religious Corporation|Religiöse Körperschaft|2=ja|3=宗教法人|4=zh|5=宗教法人|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Religious Corporation|1=religious corporation|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q7311343}}, there are 111 Shiratori Shrines nationwide, one shrine whose native name contains “Shiratori Shrine (disambiguation)” and 6 Shiratori Sha exist.

Similarly to the shrine of {{ill|Otori Shrine (disambiguation)|Otori-Schrein (Begriffsklärung)|2=ja|3=大鳥神社 (曖昧さ回避)|4=zh|5=大鳥神社 (消歧義)|lt=Ōtori Faith|lt_ja=大鳥信仰|lt_de=Otori-Glauben|lt_zh=大鳥信仰|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Otori Shrine (disambiguation)|1=Ōtori Shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q65258929}}, many are shrines of '''Shiratori Faith''' (白鳥信仰) derived from the legend of [[:en:Yamato Takeru|Yamato Takeru]]. As a {{ill|Religious Corporation|Religiöse Körperschaft|2=ja|3=宗教法人|4=zh|5=宗教法人|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Religious Corporation|1=religious corporation|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q7311343}}, there are 111 Shiratori Shrines nationwide, one shrine whose native name contains “Shiratori Shrine (disambiguation)” and 6 Shiratori Sha exist.

Similarly to the shrine of {{ill|Otori Shrine (disambiguation)|Otori-Schrein (Begriffsklärung)|2=ja|3=大鳥神社 (曖昧さ回避)|4=zh|5=大鳥神社 (消歧義)|lt=Ōtori Faith|lt_ja=大鳥信仰|lt_de=Otori-Glauben|lt_zh=大鳥信仰|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Otori Shrine (disambiguation)|1=Ōtori Shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q65258929}}, many are shrines of '''Shiratori Faith''' (白鳥信仰) derived from the legend of [[:en:Yamato Takeru|Yamato Takeru]]. As a {{ill|Religious Corporation|Religiöse Körperschaft|2=ja|3=宗教法人|4=zh|5=宗教法人|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Religious Corporation|1=religious corporation|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q7311343}}, there are 111 Shiratori Shrines nationwide, one shrine whose native name contains “Shiratori Shrine (disambiguation)” and 6 Shiratori Sha exist.

Similarly to the shrine of {{ill|Otori Shrine (disambiguation)|Otori-Schrein (Begriffsklärung)|2=ja|3=大鳥神社 (曖昧さ回避)|4=zh|5=大鳥神社 (消歧義)|lt=Ōtori Faith|lt_ja=大鳥信仰|lt_de=Otori-Glauben|lt_zh=大鳥信仰|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Otori Shrine (disambiguation)|1=Ōtori Shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q65258929}}, many are shrines of '''Shiratori Faith''' (白鳥信仰) derived from the legend of [[:en:Yamato Takeru|Yamato Takeru]]. As a {{ill|Religious Corporation|Religiöse Körperschaft|2=ja|3=宗教法人|4=zh|5=宗教法人|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Religious Corporation|1=religious corporation|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q7311343}}, there are 111 Shiratori Shrines nationwide, one shrine whose native name contains “Shiratori Shrine (disambiguation)” and 6 Shiratori Sha exist.

Similarly to the shrine of {{ill|Otori Shrine (disambiguation)|Otori-Schrein (Begriffsklärung)|2=ja|3=大鳥神社 (曖昧さ回避)|4=zh|5=大鳥神社 (消歧義)|lt=Ōtori Faith|lt_ja=大鳥信仰|lt_de=Otori-Glauben|lt_zh=大鳥信仰|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Otori Shrine (disambiguation)|1=Ōtori Shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q65258929}}, many are shrines of '''Shiratori Faith''' (白鳥信仰) derived from the legend of [[:en:Yamato Takeru|Yamato Takeru]]. As a {{ill|Religious Corporation|Religiöse Körperschaft|2=ja|3=宗教法人|4=zh|5=宗教法人|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Religious Corporation|1=religious corporation|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q7311343}}, there are 111 Shiratori Shrines nationwide, one shrine whose native name contains “Shiratori Shrine (disambiguation)” and 6 Shiratori Sha exist.

Similarly to the shrine of {{ill|Otori Shrine (disambiguation)|Otori-Schrein (Begriffsklärung)|2=ja|3=大鳥神社 (曖昧さ回避)|4=zh|5=大鳥神社 (消歧義)|lt=Ōtori Faith|lt_ja=大鳥信仰|lt_de=Otori-Glauben|lt_zh=大鳥信仰|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Otori Shrine (disambiguation)|1=Ōtori Shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q65258929}}, many are shrines of '''Shiratori Faith''' (白鳥信仰) derived from the legend of [[:en:Yamato Takeru|Yamato Takeru]]. As a {{ill|Religious Corporation|Religiöse Körperschaft|2=ja|3=宗教法人|4=zh|5=宗教法人|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Religious Corporation|1=religious corporation|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q7311343}}, there are 111 Shiratori Shrines nationwide, one shrine whose native name contains “Shiratori Shrine (disambiguation)” and 6 Shiratori Sha exist.

Similarly to the shrine of {{ill|Otori Shrine (disambiguation)|Otori-Schrein (Begriffsklärung)|2=ja|3=大鳥神社 (曖昧さ回避)|4=zh|5=大鳥神社 (消歧義)|lt=Ōtori Faith|lt_ja=大鳥信仰|lt_de=Otori-Glauben|lt_zh=大鳥信仰|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Otori Shrine (disambiguation)|1=Ōtori Shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q65258929}}, many are shrines of '''Shiratori Faith''' (白鳥信仰) derived from the legend of [[:en:Yamato Takeru|Yamato Takeru]]. As a {{ill|Religious Corporation|Religiöse Körperschaft|2=ja|3=宗教法人|4=zh|5=宗教法人|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Religious Corporation|1=religious corporation|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q7311343}}, there are 111 Shiratori Shrines nationwide, one shrine whose native name contains “Shiratori Shrine (disambiguation)” and 6 Shiratori Sha exist.

Similarly to the shrine of {{ill|Otori Shrine (disambiguation)|Otori-Schrein (Begriffsklärung)|2=ja|3=大鳥神社 (曖昧さ回避)|4=zh|5=大鳥神社 (消歧義)|lt=Ōtori Faith|lt_ja=大鳥信仰|lt_de=Otori-Glauben|lt_zh=大鳥信仰|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Otori Shrine (disambiguation)|1=Ōtori Shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q65258929}}, many are shrines of '''Shiratori Faith''' (白鳥信仰) derived from the legend of [[:en:Yamato Takeru|Yamato Takeru]]. As a {{ill|Religious Corporation|Religiöse Körperschaft|2=ja|3=宗教法人|4=zh|5=宗教法人|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Religious Corporation|1=religious corporation|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q7311343}}, there are 111 Shiratori Shrines nationwide, one shrine whose native name contains “Shiratori Shrine (disambiguation)” and 6 Shiratori Sha exist.

Similarly to the shrine of {{ill|Otori Shrine (disambiguation)|Otori-Schrein (Begriffsklärung)|2=ja|3=大鳥神社 (曖昧さ回避)|4=zh|5=大鳥神社 (消歧義)|lt=Ōtori Faith|lt_ja=大鳥信仰|lt_de=Otori-Glauben|lt_zh=大鳥信仰|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Otori Shrine (disambiguation)|1=Ōtori Shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q65258929}}, many are shrines of '''Shiratori Faith''' (白鳥信仰) derived from the legend of [[:en:Yamato Takeru|Yamato Takeru]]. As a {{ill|Religious Corporation|Religiöse Körperschaft|2=ja|3=宗教法人|4=zh|5=宗教法人|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Religious Corporation|1=religious corporation|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q7311343}}, there are 111 Shiratori Shrines nationwide, one shrine whose native name contains “Shiratori Shrine (disambiguation)” and 6 Shiratori Sha exist.

<!--interwikis from wikidata-->[[ja:白鳥神社]] <!--interwikis from wikidata-->[[ja:白鳥神社]] <!--interwikis from wikidata-->[[ja:白鳥神社]] {{afc comment|Wikidata entry [[da:d:Q11580589]] Wikidata name: [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 09:25, 11 June 2025 (UTC)}} '''Shiratori Shrine''' (白鳥神社) Shiratori Shrine (白鳥神社) is a Shinto shrine located in various parts of {{ill|Japan|en|Japan|WD=Q17|lt=Japan}}. Similarly to the shrine of {{ill|Otori Shrine (disambiguation)|Otori-Schrein (Begriffsklärung)|2=ja|3=大鳥神社 (曖昧さ回避)|4=zh|5=大鳥神社 (消歧義)|lt=Ōtori Faith|lt_ja=大鳥信仰|lt_de=Otori-Glauben|lt_zh=大鳥信仰|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Otori Shrine (disambiguation)|1=Ōtori Shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q65258929}}, many are shrines of '''Shiratori Faith''' (白鳥信仰) derived from the legend of {{ill|Yamato Takeru|en|Yamato Takeru|WD=Q461258|lt=Yamato Takeru}}. As a {{ill|Religious Corporation|Religiöse Körperschaft|2=ja|3=宗教法人|4=zh|5=宗教法人|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Religious Corporation|1=religious corporation|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q7311343}}, there are 111 Shiratori Shrines nationwide, one shrine whose native name contains “Shiratori Shrine (disambiguation)” and 6 Shiratori Sha exist.

Similarly to the shrine of {{ill|Otori Shrine (disambiguation)|Otori-Schrein (Begriffsklärung)|2=ja|3=大鳥神社 (曖昧さ回避)|4=zh|5=大鳥神社 (消歧義)|lt=Ōtori Faith|lt_ja=大鳥信仰|lt_de=Otori-Glauben|lt_zh=大鳥信仰|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Otori Shrine (disambiguation)|1=Ōtori Shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q65258929}}, many are shrines of '''Shiratori Faith''' (白鳥信仰) derived from the legend of {{ill|Yamato Takeru|en|Yamato Takeru|WD=Q461258|lt=Yamato Takeru}}. As a {{ill|Religious Corporation|Religiöse Körperschaft|2=ja|3=宗教法人|4=zh|5=宗教法人|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Religious Corporation|1=religious corporation|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q7311343}}, there are 111 Shiratori Shrines nationwide, one shrine whose native name contains “Shiratori Shrine (disambiguation)” and 6 Shiratori Sha exist.

Similarly to the shrine of {{ill|Otori Shrine (disambiguation)|Otori-Schrein (Begriffsklärung)|2=ja|3=大鳥神社 (曖昧さ回避)|4=zh|5=大鳥神社 (消歧義)|lt=Ōtori Faith|lt_ja=大鳥信仰|lt_de=Otori-Glauben|lt_zh=大鳥信仰|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Otori Shrine (disambiguation)|1=Ōtori Shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q65258929}}, many are shrines of '''Shiratori Faith''' (白鳥信仰) derived from the legend of {{ill|Yamato Takeru|en|Yamato Takeru|WD=Q461258|lt=Yamato Takeru}}. As a {{ill|Religious Corporation|Religiöse Körperschaft|2=ja|3=宗教法人|4=zh|5=宗教法人|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Religious Corporation|1=religious corporation|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q7311343}}, there are 111 Shiratori Shrines nationwide, one shrine whose native name contains “Shiratori Shrine (disambiguation)” and 6 Shiratori Sha exist.

'''Shiratori Shrine''' (白鳥神社) Shiratori Shrine (白鳥神社) is a Shinto shrine located in various parts of {{ill|Japan|en|Japan|WD=Q17|lt=Japan}}. Similarly to the shrine of {{ill|Otori Shrine (disambiguation)|Otori-Schrein (Begriffsklärung)|2=ja|3=大鳥神社 (曖昧さ回避)|4=zh|5=大鳥神社 (消歧義)|lt=Ōtori Faith|lt_ja=大鳥信仰|lt_de=Otori-Glauben|lt_zh=大鳥信仰|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Otori Shrine (disambiguation)|1=Ōtori Shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q65258929}}, many are shrines of '''Shiratori Faith''' (白鳥信仰) derived from the legend of {{ill|Yamato Takeru|en|Yamato Takeru|WD=Q461258|lt=Yamato Takeru}}. As a {{ill|Religious Corporation|Religiöse Körperschaft|2=ja|3=宗教法人|4=zh|5=宗教法人|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Religious Corporation|1=religious corporation|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q7311343}}, there are 111 Shiratori Shrines nationwide, one shrine whose native name contains “Shiratori Shrine (disambiguation)” and 6 Shiratori Sha exist.

'''Shiratori Shrine''' (白鳥神社) Shiratori Shrine (白鳥神社) is a Shinto shrine located in various parts of {{ill|Japan|en|Japan|WD=Q17|lt=Japan}}. Similarly to the shrine of {{ill|Otori Shrine (disambiguation)|Otori-Schrein (Begriffsklärung)|2=ja|3=大鳥神社 (曖昧さ回避)|4=zh|5=大鳥神社 (消歧義)|lt=Ōtori Faith|lt_ja=大鳥信仰|lt_de=Otori-Glauben|lt_zh=大鳥信仰|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Otori Shrine (disambiguation)|1=Ōtori Shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q65258929}}, many are shrines of '''Shiratori Faith''' (白鳥信仰) derived from the legend of {{ill|Yamato Takeru|en|Yamato Takeru|WD=Q461258|lt=Yamato Takeru}}. As a {{ill|Religious Corporation|Religiöse Körperschaft|2=ja|3=宗教法人|4=zh|5=宗教法人|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Religious Corporation|1=religious corporation|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q7311343}}, there are 111 Shiratori Shrines nationwide, one shrine whose native name contains “Shiratori Shrine (disambiguation)” and 6 Shiratori Sha exist.

'''Shiratori Shrine''' (白鳥神社) Shiratori Shrine (白鳥神社) is a Shinto shrine located in various parts of {{ill|Japan|en|Japan|WD=Q17|lt=Japan}}. Similarly to the shrine of {{ill|Otori Shrine (disambiguation)|Otori-Schrein (Begriffsklärung)|2=ja|3=大鳥神社 (曖昧さ回避)|4=zh|5=大鳥神社 (消歧義)|lt=Ōtori Faith|lt_ja=大鳥信仰|lt_de=Otori-Glauben|lt_zh=大鳥信仰|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Otori Shrine (disambiguation)|1=Ōtori Shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q65258929}}, many are shrines of '''Shiratori Faith''' (白鳥信仰) derived from the legend of {{ill|Yamato Takeru|en|Yamato Takeru|WD=Q461258|lt=Yamato Takeru}}. As a {{ill|Religious Corporation|Religiöse Körperschaft|2=ja|3=宗教法人|4=zh|5=宗教法人|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Religious Corporation|1=religious corporation|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q7311343}}, there are 111 Shiratori Shrines nationwide, one shrine whose native name contains “Shiratori Shrine (disambiguation)” and 6 Shiratori Sha exist.

'''Shiratori Shrine''' (白鳥神社) Shiratori Shrine (白鳥神社) is a Shinto shrine located in various parts of {{ill|Japan|en|Japan|WD=Q17|lt=Japan|1=Japan}}. Similarly to the shrine of {{ill|Otori Shrine (disambiguation)|Otori-Schrein (Begriffsklärung)|2=ja|3=大鳥神社 (曖昧さ回避)|4=zh|5=大鳥神社 (消歧義)|lt=Ōtori Faith|lt_ja=大鳥信仰|lt_de=Otori-Glauben|lt_zh=大鳥信仰|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Otori Shrine (disambiguation)|1=Ōtori Shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q65258929}}, many are shrines of '''Shiratori Faith''' (白鳥信仰) derived from the legend of {{ill|Yamato Takeru|en|Yamato Takeru|WD=Q461258|lt=Yamato Takeru|1=Yamato Takeru}}. As a {{ill|Religious Corporation|Religiöse Körperschaft|2=ja|3=宗教法人|4=zh|5=宗教法人|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Religious Corporation|1=religious corporation|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q7311343}}, there are 111 Shiratori Shrines nationwide, one shrine whose native name contains “Shiratori Shrine (disambiguation)” and 6 Shiratori Sha exist.

'''Shiratori Shrine''' (白鳥神社) Shiratori Shrine (白鳥神社) is a Shinto shrine located in various parts of {{ill|Japan|en|Japan|WD=Q17|lt=Japan|1=Japan}}. Similarly to the shrine of {{ill|Otori Shrine (disambiguation)|Otori-Schrein (Begriffsklärung)|2=ja|3=大鳥神社 (曖昧さ回避)|4=zh|5=大鳥神社 (消歧義)|lt=Ōtori Faith|lt_ja=大鳥信仰|lt_de=Otori-Glauben|lt_zh=大鳥信仰|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Otori Shrine (disambiguation)|1=Ōtori Shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q65258929}}, many are shrines of '''Shiratori Faith''' (白鳥信仰) derived from the legend of {{ill|Yamato Takeru|en|Yamato Takeru|WD=Q461258|lt=Yamato Takeru|1=Yamato Takeru}}. As a {{ill|Religious Corporation|Religiöse Körperschaft|2=ja|3=宗教法人|4=zh|5=宗教法人|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Religious Corporation|1=religious corporation|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q7311343}}, there are 111 Shiratori Shrines nationwide, one shrine whose native name contains “Shiratori Shrine (disambiguation)” and 6 Shiratori Sha exist.

'''Shiratori Shrine''' (白鳥神社) Shiratori Shrine (白鳥神社) is a Shinto shrine located in various parts of {{ill|Japan|en|Japan|WD=Q17|lt=Japan|1=Japan}}. Similarly to the shrine of {{ill|Otori Shrine (disambiguation)|Otori-Schrein (Begriffsklärung)|2=ja|3=大鳥神社 (曖昧さ回避)|4=zh|5=大鳥神社 (消歧義)|lt=Ōtori Faith|lt_ja=大鳥信仰|lt_de=Otori-Glauben|lt_zh=大鳥信仰|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Otori Shrine (disambiguation)|1=Ōtori Shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q65258929}}, many are shrines of '''Shiratori Faith''' (白鳥信仰) derived from the legend of {{ill|Yamato Takeru|en|Yamato Takeru|WD=Q461258|lt=Yamato Takeru|1=Yamato Takeru}}. As a {{ill|Religious Corporation|Religiöse Körperschaft|2=ja|3=宗教法人|4=zh|5=宗教法人|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Religious Corporation|1=religious corporation|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q7311343}}, there are 111 Shiratori Shrines nationwide, one shrine whose native name contains “Shiratori Shrine (disambiguation)” and 6 Shiratori Sha exist.

'''Shiratori Shrine''' (白鳥神社) Shiratori Shrine (白鳥神社) is a Shinto shrine located in various parts of {{ill|Japan|en|Japan|WD=Q17|lt=Japan|1=Japan}}. Similarly to the shrine of {{ill|Otori Shrine (disambiguation)|Otori-Schrein (Begriffsklärung)|2=ja|3=大鳥神社 (曖昧さ回避)|4=zh|5=大鳥神社 (消歧義)|lt=Ōtori Faith|lt_ja=大鳥信仰|lt_de=Otori-Glauben|lt_zh=大鳥信仰|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Otori Shrine (disambiguation)|1=Ōtori Shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q65258929}}, many are shrines of '''Shiratori Faith''' (白鳥信仰) derived from the legend of {{ill|Yamato Takeru|en|Yamato Takeru|WD=Q461258|lt=Yamato Takeru|1=Yamato Takeru}}. As a {{ill|Religious Corporation|Religiöse Körperschaft|2=ja|3=宗教法人|4=zh|5=宗教法人|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Religious Corporation|1=religious corporation|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q7311343}}, there are 111 Shiratori Shrines nationwide, one shrine whose native name contains “Shiratori Shrine (disambiguation)” and 6 Shiratori Sha exist.

'''Shiratori Shrine''' (白鳥神社) Shiratori Shrine (白鳥神社) is a Shinto shrine located in various parts of {{ill|Japan|en|Japan|WD=Q17|lt=Japan|1=Japan}}. Similarly to the shrine of {{ill|Otori Shrine (disambiguation)|Otori-Schrein (Begriffsklärung)|2=ja|3=大鳥神社 (曖昧さ回避)|4=zh|5=大鳥神社 (消歧義)|lt=Ōtori Faith|lt_ja=大鳥信仰|lt_de=Otori-Glauben|lt_zh=大鳥信仰|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Otori Shrine (disambiguation)|1=Ōtori Shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q65258929}}, many are shrines of '''Shiratori Faith''' (白鳥信仰) derived from the legend of {{ill|Yamato Takeru|en|Yamato Takeru|WD=Q461258|lt=Yamato Takeru|1=Yamato Takeru}}. As a {{ill|Religious Corporation|Religiöse Körperschaft|2=ja|3=宗教法人|4=zh|5=宗教法人|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Religious Corporation|1=religious corporation|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q7311343}}, there are 111 Shiratori Shrines nationwide, one shrine whose native name contains “Shiratori Shrine (disambiguation)” and 6 Shiratori Sha exist.
